scope: FoodKing Le Cayenne V1 — owner-night closeout view of stock subsystem (rapport pertes du jour / COGS / réappro suggestion / historique conso graph / achat vs vente / alerte DLC)
mission: Confirm whether owner-facing end-of-day stock features exist, partially exist, or are entirely absent. Cite primary-source files; do NOT propose new features without evidence baseline.
sources_inspected: app/Models/StockLevel.php (full read — columns: on_hand, reserved, threshold_low, manual_unavailable_reason, manual_unavailable_since)
app/Http/Controllers/Admin/StockRuptureDashboardController.php (full read — endpoints: lastSummary, lowAlerts, run, catalogOverview)
app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ItemsReportController.php (full read — sales-volume report, no cost data)
resources/js/components/admin/stock/StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue (only stock Vue page that exists prod-side)
Exhaustive grep across app/ + database/ + resources/js/ for cost_price|unit_cost|purchase_price|cogs|wastage|spoilage|expiry|shelf_life|reorder|min_stock|supplier_order|loss_report|margin|profit

what_exists: Append-only StockMovement ledger (delta per order/refund) — supplies a consumption stream IF query endpoint built
StockLevel.threshold_low column (already drives 'lowAlerts' endpoint) — supplies a reorder-trigger primitive
ItemBranchAvailability.daily_consumed_qty + daily_reset_at — daily-quota counter resettable Paris-local midnight
StockRuptureDashboardController endpoints lastSummary + lowAlerts + run + catalogOverview (read-side only)
AvailabilityService.releaseForOrderItems (cancel/refund compensating release with ledger order_items.released_qty)
what_is_definitively_absent: ZERO cost_price / unit_cost / purchase_price columns anywhere in items / item_variations / item_extras / stock_levels (grep confirmed — domain has no cost vocabulary)
ZERO COGS / margin / profit fields in SalesReportOverviewResource or ItemReportResource (grep returned empty)

stock_movements.reason ENUM = ('order_created','order_canceled','refund','manual_in','manual_out','rupture_set') — NO 'waste' / 'spoilage' / 'shrinkage' / 'expiry' value; impossible to log a loss event without schema change
No PurchaseOrder / GoodsReceipt / Supplier entity (grep zero matches across app/ models)
No ConsumptionReport / LossReport / ExpiryAlert controller, service, or route
No DLC / shelf_life / expires_at column on any stock-adjacent table

gaps.feature: Rapport pertes du jour (daily losses report)
gaps.owner_pain: À 23h le owner ne peut PAS dire 'aujourd'hui on a jeté 4 baguettes + 2 saladiers tomate'. Aucune trace.
evidence: stock_movements.reason ENUM does not include any 'waste'/'spoilage'/'shrinkage' value (database/migrations/2026_04_27_143130_create_stock_movements_table.php L17 — five reasons listed, none represent loss)
No LossReport / WasteReport controller in app/Http/Controllers/Admin/
No 'pertes' / 'losses' string in resources/js/components/admin/* (grep)
StockService manual_out reason exists but is generic — not tagged as 'loss' vs 'transfer' vs 'tasting'
gaps.min_v1_remediation: Add 'waste','expired' reason values to ENUM + manual_out controller flag; surface daily aggregate by reason in /admin/stock/daily-summary endpoint

gaps.owner_pain: Aucun pourcentage food-cost calculable. 'On vend pour 1200€ ce soir' mais ratio matière première = inconnu.
evidence: Zero cost_price / unit_cost / purchase_price column on Item, ItemExtra, ItemVariation (grep confirmed)
ItemReportResource does not project any cost field (controller fully read)
SalesReportOverviewResource does not project margin/profit (grep returned empty)
No journal d'achats (no PurchaseOrder model)
gaps.min_v1_remediation: Add nullable cost_price decimal to items + item_variations + item_extras. Project SUM(qty * cost_price) per day. Surface food_cost_pct = COGS / revenue in Z-report widget. Caveat: cost_price must be backfilled — owner-input required.
gaps.estimated_cost_v1: L (3-5 days incl. backfill UI + Z-report enrichment + acceptance with owner)

gaps.owner_pain: À la fermeture, owner doit deviner ce qu'il faut commander pour demain. Pas de liste auto 'à recommander'.
evidence: stock_levels.threshold_low column exists + lowAlerts endpoint already surfaces on_hand <= threshold_low (StockRuptureDashboardController L92-122)
BUT no 'reorder_quantity' / 'pack_size' / 'lead_time_days' field — owner can see 'low' but cannot see 'commander combien'
No supplier link / no PurchaseOrder draft generation
gaps.min_v1_remediation: Add target_stock + reorder_qty columns; transform lowAlerts into a 'replenishment suggestion list' with computed need = target_stock - on_hand. Phase 2: supplier-grouped PDF/email export.
gaps.estimated_cost_v1: S-M (1 day schema + 0.5 day endpoint + 0.5 day Vue list)

gaps.owner_pain: Owner ne peut pas voir tendance: 'le bol thaï se vend deux fois plus le vendredi'. Pas de courbe.
evidence: stock_movements is append-only with branch_id + stockable + delta + created_at — raw data SUPPORTS time-series aggregation
BUT no /api/admin/stock/consumption?from=&to=&group_by=day endpoint exists (grep)
No chart Vue component in resources/js/components/admin/stock/ — only StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue (rupture-table only)
ItemsReportListComponent.vue is a flat table sorted by qty — no time bucketing
gaps.min_v1_remediation: Add /api/admin/stock/consumption endpoint (GROUP BY DATE(created_at), stockable_id) + Vue ChartComponent (existing Chart.js in vendor.js). Reuse stock_movements_branch_level_created_idx index.

gaps.feature: Comparaison achat vs vente (purchased qty vs sold qty)
gaps.owner_pain: Owner ne peut pas détecter écart 'j'ai acheté 10 kg de viande, j'en ai vendu 6, où sont les 4?' — fondamental pour repérer vol/perte/erreur portion.
gaps.existence_in_codebase: ABSENT — no purchase side at all
evidence: No PurchaseOrder / GoodsReceipt / Invoice-supplier model in app/Models/ (find returned only ItemsReportExport)
stock_movements has 'manual_in' reason but no concept of 'received from supplier X' — just a numeric increment
Owner reconciliation = impossible because purchase side does not exist as data
gaps.min_v1_remediation: V1 dépasse scope. V1.0.X minimum: turn 'manual_in' into a sub-typed event with supplier_id + invoice_ref. V2 SaaS: full supplier+PO module.
gaps.estimated_cost_v1: L+ (5+ days for honest V1.0.X supplier-tagged manual_in)

gaps.owner_pain: Aucune notification 'ces 3 saladiers arrivent à DLC demain'. Critical pour fast-food avec produits frais (viande hachée, salades préparées). Risque sanitaire + perte économique.
gaps.existence_in_codebase: ABSENT — no expiry vocabulary in schema
evidence: No expires_at / dlc / shelf_life_days column on any stock-adjacent table (grep across all migrations)
stock_levels schema has on_hand/reserved/threshold_low only — no expiry dimension
No batch / lot / serial tracking — current model is a single integer on_hand per (branch, stockable), so two batches with different DLC are indistinguishable
No notification system for expiry (PushNotification model exists for orders, no expiry trigger)
gaps.min_v1_remediation: Honest V1 path: add nullable expires_at + batch tracking table (stock_batches: branch_id, stockable_id, on_hand, expires_at). Daily cron flags 'expires_within_24h' batches; dashboard widget. CAVEAT: requires rework of stock_movements to be batch-aware — significant.
gaps.estimated_cost_v1: L (4-6 days incl. batch model + cron + UI)

verdict.global: RED — owner end-of-day stock perspective is essentially non-existent in V1
verdict.reasoning: The codebase has a clean technical stock primitive (StockLevel + append-only StockMovement + AvailabilityService) but treats stock purely as an AVAILABILITY problem (is the item orderable? auto-86 yes/no?), NOT as an OWNER-NIGHT INVENTORY problem (what did I lose, what did I sell vs buy, what expires, what to reorder, what is my food cost). 6/6 owner-night questions land on either ABSENT (4) or PARTIAL primitive without surfacing (2). The schema has no cost vocabulary and no expiry/batch vocabulary — both are structural gaps requiring migration work, not just controller polish.
verdict.v1_recommendation: ACCEPT V1 ships without these owner-night features IF owner has been told explicitly that V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne = 'stock = ne pas vendre ce qui manque' and NOT 'stock = clôture comptable matière'. If owner expectation is full inventory module, V1 is NOT shippable as 'production-ready for owner closeout'. Defer G2 + G5 to V2/SaaS; treat G1 + G3 + G6 as V1.0.1 candidates IF owner gates.

top_3.label: Rapport pertes du jour ABSENT — stock_movements.reason ENUM has zero loss vocabulary
top_3.why_top: Highest owner-pain-to-fix-cost ratio. Schema change (add ENUM value + UI flag) is M-size but unlocks the closeout question 'qu'est-ce qu'on a perdu?' which is the most asked owner-night question in fast-food.

top_3.label: Alerte DLC ABSENT — no expires_at / batch / shelf_life column anywhere
top_3.why_top: Sanitary + economic compounded risk. Fast-food fresh products (viande hachée, salades, sauces ouvertes) need DLC tracking — this is also a HACCP-adjacent compliance gap, not just a UX gap.

top_3.label: Suggestion de réappro PARTIAL — threshold_low exists but no reorder_qty / target_stock primitive
top_3.why_top: Cheapest win of the six. Owner currently sees 'these items are low' but not 'commande ces quantités'. Adding target_stock + auto-suggest is S-M effort and converts an existing widget from informative to actionable.

open_questions_for_owner: Owner Q: V1 Le Cayenne ship-as-is sans rapport pertes / DLC / réappro suggestion — accepted ou bloquant?
Owner Q: Veux-tu introduire cost_price (G2 COGS) maintenant en V1.0.1 ou repousser V2 SaaS? Backfill = 70-150 SKUs à saisir manuellement.
Owner Q: Si DLC ajouté (G6), accepter rework du modèle stock vers batch-tracked (lot avec expires_at)? Sinon 'expiry approximative item-level' acceptable comme V1.0.1?
out_of_scope_for_v1: Multi-batch DLC with FIFO/LIFO consumption — V2
Predictive reorder via ML consumption forecast — V2
Auto-COGS recompute on recipe change — V2
